$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URL or path

mode.description: Output directory mode: fast, full, or both (default: both)

source.description: Custom dictionary location (URL / file) instead of bundled; '{mode}' is replaced by fast/full

keepFormat.description: Keep 'format' keyword next to the injected 'pattern'

onUnresolved.description: Behavior for formats without pattern (e.g. regex, int32); default: keep

includeDotDirs.description: Include dot-directories below schema/<version> (boolean for all, or string array for specific names)

lintRegex.description: Warn about generated patterns the target engine cannot handle (re2: no lookaround or backreferences)

maxPatternLength.description: Warn about generated patterns longer than n characters

strict.description: Exit 1 when a format could not be converted or a lint warning was raised
